mesh.definition: backlash = free rotation window of the second gear (pinion or follower) with the first fixed, x pitch radius of the moving gear (circumferential, nominal pitch circle); gap = minimum distance between the two outlines at the neutral (window-centre) pose of the closed-pose phasing; poses = crank offsets from the closed pose (+ opens)

interference_3d.reading: gear-body (teeth, 36T layer, 24T layer) interference is 0 at every pose.  At -30 deg (30 deg PAST the closed stop, not an operating pose: the jaw tips meet at 0) the compound and follower lugs overlap each other; the first lug-to-lug contact is at lug_vs_lug_overtravel_limit_deg.
interference_3d.note: OCC boolean common volume of the full solids, three gear pairs; the positive control turns the second gear 3 deg out of the clearance window and must show overlap

notes.pinion_interface: His pinion has NO horn or torque interface: through bore D8.00 against the D6 servo shaft (4 mm engagement, 1 mm radial gap), no spline, no screws, no horn pocket.  Reported, not changed.
notes.follower_pivot_hole: His follower pivot hole is D8.33 (not D3.5) -- kept as his.  His compound pivot hole is D3.5.
notes.pivot_hole_d4: Pivot holes stay D3.5 (M3 clearance).  D4 shoulder screws would need D4.2 holes (not applied).
notes.bearing_pockets: D14.075 pockets with D14.000 x 1.95 entry lips (8 lip segments with R0.25 relief notches, as his) are his faces, untouched.
notes.pinion_boss_gap: Pinion top is flush with the servo-boss plane in v6.  The 0.30 mm gap is realised by placing the boss plane at pinion top + 0.30 (a housing / servo-side dimension; the pinion is not changed).
notes.relief_flag: The 0.30 mm annular relief (R16.5 .. tip, z 15.7..16) on the 36T layer top face is the ONLY change beyond tooth count and crank length; _norelief export has none.
